_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_mechanics#4 — a Thermo_Structure_Interaction structural mesh must use SOLIDSCATRA elements, and the failure names neither the coupling nor the right element. Three arms on the upstream deck tests/input_files/tsi_heatflux_iterstaggaitken.4C.yaml (three SOLIDSCATRA HEX8 cells), run 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C. Observed: the untouched deck exits 0 with 'processor 0 finished normally'; swapping SOLIDSCATRA for SOLID and dropping the SOLIDSCATRA-only 'TYPE Undefined' key exits 1 with 'Unsupported solid element type!' from tsi/4C_tsi_utils.cpp line 76 — a message that mentions neither SOLIDSCATRA nor the thermal discretisation it failed to clone; and swapping SOLIDSCATRA for SOLID while KEEPING 'TYPE Undefined' never gets that far, because TYPE is not a SOLID key, so the element line stops parsing with "After parsing, the line still contains 'TYPE Undefined'." This also keeps the entry's own correction pinned: CLAIMED_TSI_TEXTS=0 asserts that 'no SCATRA discretisation found' and the file name 4C_tsi_factory.cpp appear nowhere, since neither exists in the binary.
expect_in_output: After parsing, the line still contains 'TYPE Undefined'.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the SOLIDSCATRA elements alone in the second arm. The TSI clone then succeeds, 'Unsupported solid element type!' disappears and EXIT_SOLID becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: sed 's/SOLIDSCATRA HEX8/SOLID HEX8/; s/ TYPE Undefined//' "$BASE" > "$TMP/solid.yaml"

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the third arm too. The element line parses, the leftover-token message disappears and EXIT_SOLID_WITHTYPE becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
